title: Experience and Leveling
body:
Syntax: score  |  prompt

Description: Ninja levels use the cumulative XP curve (level - 1) cubed, times 1,000. A same-level mob awards about 5% of the current level's XP band before bonuses; easier mobs lose 10% reward per level below the player (zero at ten levels below), while harder mobs gain 3% per level (capped at 130%).

Rank level caps: Student 10, Genin 35, Chunin 100, Special Jonin 200, Jonin 250, Kage 250. Genin and Chunin must pass their required exams or promotion gates before progressing past their cap. Jounin unlocks at level 200 and may level to 250. Kage is an Implementor-only appointment, not an earned promotion.

Level 100+ training awards 2 training points per level. Mastered-jutsu breakthroughs grant additional combat damage at levels 100, 125, 150, 175, 200, 225 and 250 if the jutsu has 100% proficiency. The final 25 levels have increased XP costs.

Date: 2026-11-12
